summary: A candidate is confined to the files its plan names: after the worker's diff is read and before validation, audit, review or admission, every changed path -- added, modified, deleted or renamed -- must be one the plan named; any other path refuses the candidate, and no test-edit grant enlarges the named set.
plan: In runCandidate (internal/workflow/engine.go), immediately after the read-only (ModeInspect) refusal and before the candidate.changed event and e.validate, refuse a candidate whose diff touches any path the plan did not name: the paths come from report.FromDiff(diff).Files (every status, deletions and renames included), the named set is tc.Files canonicalised with path.Clean(strings.TrimSpace(f)) exactly as architecturalFiles does, and the refusal error names every path outside the plan and the plan's named files. Put the check in one function beside inspectTestEdits and diffFileStates in internal/workflow/testedit.go, taking the diff and the named files only -- it must not take or read test-edit grants, so a grant cannot enlarge the set. The refusal returns from runCandidate the way the ModeInspect refusal does, so nothing downstream (validation, audit, Level-1 classification, review, admission) sees a wider candidate; the candidate worktree is left as it is. Tests in internal/workflow/testedit_test.go: TestCandidateWiderThanPlanIsRefusedBeforeReview (a diff touching one path outside the plan is refused, naming the path; a diff touching only named paths passes; a deletion outside the plan is refused), TestOperationalTestGrantDoesNotExpandPlanScope (the function has no grant input, and a test file that would be grantable but is not named is refused), TestGovernancePathClassificationCannotMaskScopeWidening (a diff touching internal/workflow/routine.go plus one unnamed path is refused by this check -- it does not depend on any Level-1 classification). Test in internal/workflow/suppliedplan_test.go: TestASuppliedPlanIsNotWidenedByTheCandidate (a candidate wider than a supplied plan is refused and the supplied plan's Digest and Files are unchanged). No other behaviour changes; no signature changes; no new files.
steps: Add the confinement check function in internal/workflow/testedit.go: input diff and the plan's named files; output an error naming every path outside the plan, or nil.
Call it in runCandidate in internal/workflow/engine.go right after the ModeInspect refusal and before the candidate.changed event; return the error the way that refusal returns.
Add the three tests to internal/workflow/testedit_test.go and the supplied-plan test to internal/workflow/suppliedplan_test.go; use unified-diff strings built in the tests.
Run gofmt -l cmd internal, go vet ./..., and go test ./... .
consequences: A worker that touches a path the plan did not name no longer reaches validation, audit, review or admission; the plan must be revised and the run repeated. Candidates within their plan behave exactly as before.

claims.statement: runCandidate refuses a read-only plan whose candidate changed files immediately before emitting candidate.changed and calling e.validate; no candidate-vs-plan comparison exists on that path.
taskContext.Files are the paths the plan names; changedPaths(diff) omits deleted files, so the check reads report.FromDiff(diff).Files directly.
inspectTestEdits inspects only granted files and diffFileStates already classifies every changed path by status; neither compares the candidate to the plan.
